node.label: Electrodynamic Brake Toggle from A Cabin
Electrodynamic Brake Toggle from B Cabin

object.script:
local reverserCounter = {value = 0, prev = 0} local throttleCounter = {value = 0, prev = 0} local function boolStepCounter(state, forward, backward, step, minVal, maxVal) local dir = 0 if forward and not backward then dir = 1 elseif backward and not forward then dir = -1 end
if dir ~= state.prev then state.value = math.max( minVal, math.min(maxVal, state.value + dir * step) ) end state.prev = dir return state.value end
function parse(a) for i = 1, math.min(#a, 7) do output.setBool(i + 24, a[i]) end end
a = {false, false, false, false, false, false, false}
A_reverserToggle,B_reverserToggle,AtoggleEDT,BtoggleEDT,reverserHandleRelayA,reverserHandleRelayB,prev_plus_state,prev_minus_state,from_seatPlus,from_seatMinus = false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false throttle,reverserHandlePos,clutch,directThrottle,current_position,prev_seat_state,traction,from_seat = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 reverserHandleIndex = 0 -- 2 - Electrodynamic Brake Mode | 1 - Forward | 0 - Neutral | -1 - Backward | -2 - Error | -3 - Off
function onTick() A_reverserForward = input.getBool(1) A_reverserBackward = input.getBool(2) A_reverserToggle = input.getBool(3) B_reverserForward = input.getBool(4) B_reverserBackward = input.getBool(5) B_reverserToggle = input.getBool(6)
AtoggleEDT = input.getBool(7) BtoggleEDT = input.getBool(8) toggleEDT = property.getBool("Electrodynamic Brake is ON?") seatBtnOne = input.getBool(9) seatBtnTwo = input.getBool(10)
--serviceBrakeReq = input.getBool(11) emergencyBrakeReq = input.getBool(12)
position_count = property.getNumber("Position Count") min_traction = property.getNumber("Minimum Traction") max_traction = property.getNumber("Maximum Traction") control_axis = property.getNumber("Control Axis") incrementMode = property.getBool("Control Mode") inc_traction = property.getNumber("Traction Increment")
if control_axis == 1 then from_seat = input.getNumber(1) elseif control_axis == 2 then from_seat = input.getNumber(2) elseif control_axis == 3 then from_seat = input.getNumber(3) elseif control_axis == 4 then from_seat = input.getNumber(4) elseif control_axis == 5 then from_seatPlus = input.getBool(9) from_seatMinus = input.getBool(10) end
if reverserHandleIndex == 0 or reverserHandleIndex == -3 then from_seat, from_seatPlus, from_seatMinus = 0, false, false end
if control_axis >= 1 and control_axis <= 4 then if from_seat > 0 and prev_seat_state <= 0 then current_position = current_position + 1 elseif from_seat < 0 and prev_seat_state >= 0 then current_position = current_position - 1 end prev_seat_state = from_seat end
if control_axis == 5 then if from_seatPlus and not prev_plus_state then current_position = current_position + 1 end if from_seatMinus and not prev_minus_state then current_position = current_position - 1 end prev_plus_state = from_seatPlus prev_minus_state = from_seatMinus end
current_position = math.max(0, math.min(current_position, position_count)) if emergencyBrakeReq == true then traction = 0 prev_seat_state = 0 prev_plus_state = false prev_minus_state = false current_position = 0 else if current_position == 0 then traction = 0 elseif position_count <= 1 then traction = min_traction else if incrementMode then traction = min_traction + (current_position - 1) * inc_traction traction = math.min(traction, max_traction) else local t = (current_position - 1) / (position_count - 1) traction = min_traction + t * (max_traction - min_traction) end end end throttle = traction
if throttle ~= 0 then A_reverserForward = false A_reverserBackward = false B_reverserForward = false B_reverserBackward = false end
if not (A_reverserToggle and B_reverserToggle) then if A_reverserToggle then reverserHandlePos = boolStepCounter(reverserCounter, A_reverserForward, A_reverserBackward, 1, -1, 2)
if reverserHandlePos == 2 then directThrottle = throttle * 0 reverserHandleIndex = 2
elseif reverserHandlePos == 1 then directThrottle = throttle reverserHandleIndex = 1
elseif reverserHandlePos == 0 then directThrottle = throttle * 0 reverserHandleIndex = 0
elseif reverserHandlePos == -1 then directThrottle = -throttle reverserHandleIndex = -1
end
reverserHandleRelayA = true reverserHandleRelayB = false elseif B_reverserToggle then reverserHandlePos = boolStepCounter(reverserCounter, B_reverserForward, B_reverserBackward, 1, -1, 2)
if reverserHandlePos == 2 then directThrottle = throttle * 0 reverserHandleIndex = 2
elseif reverserHandlePos == 1 then directThrottle = -throttle reverserHandleIndex = 1
elseif reverserHandlePos == 0 then directThrottle = throttle * 0 reverserHandleIndex = 0
elseif reverserHandlePos == -1 then directThrottle = throttle reverserHandleIndex = -1
end
reverserHandleRelayA = false reverserHandleRelayB = true else directThrottle = 0 reverserHandleIndex = -3 reverserCounter.value = 0 reverserCounter.prev = 0 reverserHandlePos = 0
reverserHandleRelayA = true reverserHandleRelayB = true end
elseif (A_reverserToggle and B_reverserToggle) then reverserHandleIndex = -2 directThrottle = 0 reverserCounter.value = 0 reverserCounter.prev = 0 reverserHandlePos = 0
reverserHandleRelayA = true reverserHandleRelayB = true end
if toggleEDT then if (AtoggleEDT or BtoggleEDT) and reverserHandleIndex == 2 then if current_position == 0 then clutch = 0 elseif current_position == 1 then clutch = 0.35 elseif current_position == 2 then clutch = 0.6 elseif current_position == 3 then clutch = 0.85 elseif current_position >= 4 then clutch = 1.0 end else clutch = 0 end end
if reverserHandleIndex == 2 then a = {true, false, false, true, true, true, true} parse(a) elseif reverserHandleIndex == 1 then a = {true, false, false, false, true, true, true} parse(a) elseif reverserHandleIndex == 0 then a = {true, true, true, true, true, true, false} parse(a) elseif reverserHandleIndex == -1 then a = {false, false, true, true, true, true, true} parse(a) elseif reverserHandleIndex == -2 then a = {false, false, false, false, false, false, true} parse(a) elseif reverserHandleIndex == -3 then a = {false, false, false, false, false, false, false} parse(a) end
output.setNumber(1, reverserHandlePos) output.setNumber(2, reverserHandleIndex) output.setNumber(3, directThrottle) output.setNumber(4, clutch) output.setNumber(5, throttle) output.setNumber(8, math.floor(current_position / 10)) output.setNumber(16, current_position % 10) output.setBool(8, reverserHandleRelayA) output.setBool(9, reverserHandleRelayB) end
